_comment: Hornero recommended Claude Code settings. Copy into your project's .claude/settings.json (or merge with your existing file). The 'hooks' block wires Hornero's scripts into Claude Code lifecycle events — soft by default (warn, don't block); the aggressive variants live under _optional_hooks for opt-in. Hook shape: each event maps to an array of { matcher, hooks: [{ type: 'command', command }] }. PostToolUse/PreToolUse hooks receive JSON on stdin; the edited path is tool_input.file_path.

hooks.command: echo '↪ Hornero here. Tell me what you'\''re working on and I'\''ll find the right lens. Scan CATALOG.md first, then load only the chosen ROLE.md + SKILL.md.'

command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *SKILL.md) <path-to-hornero>/scripts/validate-skill.sh "$f" || echo '⚠ validate-skill warned — see above. Hook is non-blocking; fix before committing.';; esac

_optional_hooks._comment: Opt-in guardrails. Merge each entry's event/matcher/hooks into hooks{} above to enable. Each one trades agent ergonomics for stricter invariants — adopt incrementally. Replace <path-to-hornero> with your hornero clone path.

PreToolUse_block_invalid_skill._when: You want a SKILL.md edit blocked if the file on disk already violates anatomy. PreToolUse fires before the write, so this validates the pre-edit file, not the result (and skips files that do not exist yet); the PostToolUse variant is the one that checks the edit's result. Aggressive: exit 2 blocks the tool call.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *SKILL.md) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; <path-to-hornero>/scripts/validate-skill.sh "$f" || exit 2;; esac

PostToolUse_auto_catalog_regen._when: You want CATALOG.md kept in sync automatically after any description-line change. Re-runs catalog.sh and stages the result. Adds latency to every SKILL/ROLE edit.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *SKILL.md|*ROLE.md) ( cd <path-to-hornero> && ./scripts/catalog.sh > /dev/null && git diff --quiet CATALOG.md || git add CATALOG.md ) ;; esac

PreCommit_smoke_check._when: Not a Claude Code hook — a git pre-commit hook. Install with: ln -s ../../scripts/smoke-check.sh .git/hooks/pre-commit. Runs full validate-skill + catalog-drift before any commit.

_notes: permissions.defaultMode: 'auto' lets the harness auto-approve known-safe tools.
model: 'sonnet' is the default for new tasks; switch to opus for planning / haiku for trivial edits.
hooks.SessionStart primes the dispatcher behaviour at every session-start.

hooks.PostToolUse runs validate-skill.sh after SKILL.md edits and warns on failure. It reads the touched path from the hook's stdin JSON (tool_input.file_path) via jq and no-ops when jq is missing or the path is empty, so it is safe by default.

hooks.Stop automatically runs the extract-lesson skill at session end via hooks/auto-extract-lesson.sh — the agent self-filters (says 'no lessons to extract' on routine sessions, proposes durable updates when there's signal). Opt out per-session with HORNERO_NO_AUTO_EXTRACT=1.
_optional_hooks are examples — merge into hooks{} when you want stricter guardrails. Aggressive variants (blocking, auto-regen) trade agent ergonomics for invariants; adopt incrementally.
